result:
I shipped the vocabulary change as v31.64 (commit fa4c356e). Every string a player reads that meant an AI human now says "pillager bot(s)". The only on-screen "raider" I found was the bush hint, and it's fixed.

The preflight passed, and the gate passed. The seed 4242 fingerprint is unchanged (ents 85/374, containers 165/593).

- **New check:** it goes through the settings rows, the "pillager bots" option, the kind-to-word tables, the sound key, the roadmap, the heat terms and the callouts. It also draws a real raid board and expects "CURRENT PILLAGER BOTS". I didn't run it on the old build, so I haven't seen it fail there. The old wording ("AI pillagers", "raiders who hide in them too") was in the page, though.
- **Old checks:** six old checks in `tools/mkfixture.ps1` looked for the old words (the board title, the extraction callout, the sound key). I retargeted them first, in their own commit (6fd7de35), and made them accept both wordings.

I left these alone because they are his edited lines or fall outside the scope:
- **His edited lines:** "Beware of hostile robots and fellow pillagers", the "a pillager wearing their name" hire line and the "pillager who had not raised a hand" notoriety line. His wording replaces the original text, so rewording the original text would drop his version. The last-pillager-walking-out line near line 5157 is his too.
- **Feedback chips:** "Pillagers felt human" and "Pillagers felt dumb" are his tags, so I didn't reword them. They mean the AI ones. He may want "pillager bots felt …".
- **Other:** the `setraid` armour set, the dev sound-lab labels "BOUNTY PILLAGER: …", and the dated history patch notes are unchanged.

The notes file `tools/handoff/console/notes/08-vocab-pillager-bots.md` lists every string changed (before and after) and these exceptions for the coordinator.

TASK DONE
